name: AI-PROMPT-music-f8cb25ae36ae
annotation:
Day-phase ambient bed for the island hub; seamless loop

Dark maritime ambient music loop for the day phase of a 1930s cursed-island survival game. Slow low strings and cello drone in D minor, a distant foghorn swell roughly every 20 seconds, faint sea chorus and rope creaks, sparse felt piano with tape hiss. Muted teal-and-brass palette mood: hopeful but never bright. 90-120 seconds, seamless loop, no melody hooks, no vocals, no drums. Deliver 48 kHz WAV plus OGG; loopable.
